Based on the provided chest X-ray image, I do not see any surgical instruments visible in either the right or left lung. The image shows the typical structures of the chest, including the lungs, heart, and ribs.

However, it is important to note that the absence of visible surgical instruments does not definitively rule out the possibility of a surgical procedure having been performed. Some surgical instruments may be radiolucent (allowing X-rays to pass through) and therefore not visible on a standard chest X-ray.

If there is a concern about a possible surgical procedure, further imaging studies, such as a CT scan, may be necessary to evaluate the chest cavity more thoroughly.
